description: Second held-out set, written before the paraphrase-recognition change. Focuses on paraphrased requests and on topic mentions of the paraphrase vocabulary (chart, graph, photo, clip, scenario, ...), so gains in recall can be weighed against new false positives. Same labeling rules and groups as v0.1. Do not tune rules against this file.
